source: Tester report plus source-level pending-request trace
precondition: The signed-in user opens Profile > Settings > Notifications
The user taps send test streak reminder
A save-streak reconciliation overlaps the five-second DEBUG delay
root_cause_evidence: reconcileSaveStreakReminder removes every pending request whose identifier starts with recme.save-streak-reminder.; that set includes recme.save-streak-reminder.debug, so an overlapping reconciliation cancels the test request before it fires.
expected: Production reminder reconciliation must replace only recme.save-streak-reminder.daily and leave the DEBUG test request pending long enough to deliver.
